The teacher choose this proposal for our project 
PROJECT PROPOSAL
Design and implementation of an internship management and
University-Enterprise matching platform "Stag.io"
1. CONTEXT AND MOTIVATION
Within the framework of the Ministry's (MESRS) strategy to strengthen the
University-Enterprise link and digitize administration, this project aims to solve the increasing
difficulty students face in finding internships and companies face in finding suitable profiles.
Currently, the management of internship agreements (Conventions de Stage) is manual, slow,
and bureaucratic. This project proposes a centralized solution to automate this workflow.
2. PROJECT OBJECTIVES
The main objective is to develop a full-stack web application that allows for:
1. Facilitating "Matching": Connecting supply (Companies) and demand (Students) via
a skill-based filtering system.
2. Digitizing Administration: Automatically generating official documents (Internship
Agreements, Certificates).
3. Centralized Tracking: Enabling the university administration to validate and track
student placements.
3. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
A. Student Space
● Authentication: Secure registration (University Email recommended).
● Digital CV: Form to fill in personal details, and specifically select technical skills
(Tags: React, Java, Python...) and add a GitHub/Portfolio link.
● Search: Internship offers search tool with filters: By Wilaya, tech, internship type … etc
● Application: Sends the profile to the company.
B. Company Space (Recruiter)
● Profile Management: Company presentation page (Logo, Description, Location).
● Offer Management: Create, Modify, and Delete internship offers.
● Candidate Tracking: Dashboard to view students who have applied.
○ Action: Accept (Triggers the administrative procedure) or Refuse a candidate.
C. Administration Space (Dept. Head/Internship Office)
● Validation: When a company accepts a student, the admin receives a notification to
validate the internship.
● Document Generation: Once validated, the system automatically generates the
"Internship Agreement" (Convention de Stage) in PDF format, pre-filled with data from
the student, company, and university.
● Statistics: Global view (Number of students placed vs. unplaced).
© Adil Chekati, PhD Page 1 of 2
L3TI workshop (Atelier) 2025-2026 – 2nd Semester
4. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
The student is free to choose the tools, but the following architecture is recommended to
ensure maintainability and pedagogical relevance:
● Architecture: Web Application.
● Frontend: ReactJS or VueJS, AngularJS … etc
● Backend: NodeJS (Express) or PHP (Laravel) / Python (Django/FastAPI).
● Database: MongoDB (NoSQL) or MySQL/PostgreSQL (Relational).
● Specific Modules: Authentication System (JWT).
6. TARGETED SKILLS (Pedagogy)
By the end of this project, the student should master:
● The Web Development Life Cycle (Analysis, Design, Dev, Test).
● Data Modeling.
● File Manipulation
● Deploying an application
